ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85:15 ratio of low-intensity (dark charcoal) to high-intensity (white/light gray) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous dark base pigmentation. High-contrast white linear filaments and circular annular patterns are distributed non-uniformly. Dense, high-intensity white pixel clusters are localized at the extreme left and right lateral tips (distal lobe edges).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped indentation with a calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 65 degrees and a vertical depth of approximately 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the entire trailing edge; frequency of peaks increases towards the lateral tips with variable pixel amplitudes ranging from subtle waves to sharp indentations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves sweeping upwards and outwards from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and annular high-contrast white pixel clusters (rosettes) ranging in diameter, concentrated primarily in the central region and across the mid-section of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of distinct, high-contrast white linear pixel disruptions (scratches/rake marks) varying in length and orientation across both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense clusters of white barnacle colonies at the proximal and distal lateral tips; significant linear rake marks and circular scarring distributed across the ventral surface.
